value.title: Episode 1
value.synopsis: Aoi Tokura is a new part-time employee at the Rainy Color café. He's also surrounded by a colorful cast of coworkers.

value.title: Episode 2
value.synopsis: The owner, Koji, is always missing or goofing off. What exactly does he do all day?

value.title: Episode 3
value.synopsis: The guys help open up shop while Keiichi finds himself distracted by a digital manga.

value.title: Episode 4
value.synopsis: Is there a secret to get on Keiichi's good side? Rain may have found the answer.

value.title: Episode 5
value.synopsis: Despite having completely different personalities, Ryota has big plans for him and Keiichi.

value.title: Episode 6
value.synopsis: Aoi is used to being called a girl, but what do the others think about it?

value.title: Episode 7
value.synopsis: Ryota steps in to try and settle Keiichi and Aoi's little misunderstanding.

value.title: Episode 8
value.synopsis: Ryota tries to "sweet talk" Keiichi into forgiving Aoi.

value.title: Episode 9
value.synopsis: Keiichi and Aoi get some helpful advice about their conflict.

value.title: Episode 10
value.synopsis: During a slow day at the café, Shion and Aoi talk about relationships.

value.title: Episode 11
value.synopsis: Aoi and Keiichi want to talk but just can't seem to find each other.

value.title: Episode 12
value.synopsis: Everyone comes together and Aoi and Keiichi finally understand one another.
